title: constant-time key verify short-circuits on first match
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/auth.rs, trusted_keys.iter().any(|k| bool::from(k.to_bytes().ct_eq(...))) short-circuits on the first matching key. The number of keys scanned leaks via timing even though each individual comparison uses ct_eq. An attacker observing response latency can determine which index in the key list matched. Use a fold that always scans all keys before returning.
